#ifndef UVM_REG_ORDERED_MAP_H_
#define UVM_REG_ORDERED_MAP_H_

#include <list>
#include <map>
#include <utility>

namespace uvm {

//----------------------------------------------------------------------
// CLASS: uvm_reg_ordered_map
//
//! Associative container with a std::map-like interface which iterates
//! its elements in insertion order instead of key order.
//!
//! The register model keeps its blocks, maps, registers and memories in
//! containers keyed by object pointer. Iterating a std::map keyed by
//! pointer visits the objects in address order, which depends on the
//! allocator. This container makes the iteration order deterministic:
//! the order in which the elements were added.
//!
//! Iterators remain valid until the element they refer to is erased.
//----------------------------------------------------------------------

template <typename K, typename V>
class uvm_reg_ordered_map
{
 public:
  typedef K key_type;
  typedef V mapped_type;
  typedef std::pair<const K, V> value_type;

 private:
  typedef std::list<value_type> list_type;

 public:
  typedef typename list_type::iterator iterator;
  typedef typename list_type::const_iterator const_iterator;
  typedef typename list_type::size_type size_type;

  uvm_reg_ordered_map() {}

  uvm_reg_ordered_map( const uvm_reg_ordered_map& other )
  : m_list(other.m_list)
  {
    m_rebuild_index();
  }

  uvm_reg_ordered_map& operator=( const uvm_reg_ordered_map& other )
  {
    if (this != &other)
    {
      m_list = other.m_list;
      m_rebuild_index();
    }
    return *this;
  }

  iterator begin() { return m_list.begin(); }
  iterator end() { return m_list.end(); }
  const_iterator begin() const { return m_list.begin(); }
  const_iterator end() const { return m_list.end(); }

  size_type size() const { return m_list.size(); }
  bool empty() const { return m_list.empty(); }

  void clear()
  {
    m_index.clear();
    m_list.clear();
  }

  iterator find( const K& key )
  {
    typename index_type::iterator it = m_index.find(key);
    return (it == m_index.end()) ? m_list.end() : it->second;
  }

  const_iterator find( const K& key ) const
  {
    typename index_type::const_iterator it = m_index.find(key);
    return (it == m_index.end()) ? m_list.end() : const_iterator(it->second);
  }

  size_type count( const K& key ) const
  {
    return m_index.count(key);
  }

  std::pair<iterator, bool> insert( const value_type& value )
  {
    iterator it = find(value.first);
    if (it != m_list.end())
      return std::make_pair(it, false);
    it = m_list.insert(m_list.end(), value);
    m_index[value.first] = it;
    return std::make_pair(it, true);
  }

  V& operator[]( const K& key )
  {
    return insert(value_type(key, V())).first->second;
  }

  size_type erase( const K& key )
  {
    typename index_type::iterator it = m_index.find(key);
    if (it == m_index.end())
      return 0;
    m_list.erase(it->second);
    m_index.erase(it);
    return 1;
  }

  //! Erase the element at \p pos and return the iterator to the next one
  iterator erase( iterator pos )
  {
    m_index.erase(pos->first);
    return m_list.erase(pos);
  }

 private:
  typedef std::map<K, iterator> index_type;

  void m_rebuild_index()
  {
    m_index.clear();
    for (iterator it = m_list.begin(); it != m_list.end(); ++it)
      m_index[it->first] = it;
  }

  list_type m_list;
  index_type m_index;
};

} // namespace uvm

#endif // UVM_REG_ORDERED_MAP_H_

// The register model must return its blocks, maps, registers and memories
// in creation order, independent of where the objects live in memory.
// All objects are constructed in storage at descending addresses, so that
// address order is the reverse of creation order.

#include <systemc>
#include <uvm>

#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <new>

using namespace uvm;

static const int N = 4;

class reg_t : public uvm_reg
{
 public:
  uvm_reg_field* f;

  reg_t( const std::string& name = "reg_t" )
  : uvm_reg(name, 8, UVM_NO_COVERAGE), f(nullptr)
  {}

  virtual void build()
  {
    f = uvm_reg_field::type_id::create("f");
    f->configure(this, 8, 0, "RW", false, 0, true, false, true);
  }
};

class mem_t : public uvm_mem
{
 public:
  mem_t( const std::string& name = "mem_t" )
  : uvm_mem(name, 16, 8)
  {}
};

class sub_t : public uvm_reg_block
{
 public:
  sub_t( const std::string& name = "sub_t" )
  : uvm_reg_block(name)
  {}
};

// Storage for the objects; element N-1 has the lowest index but is used first
template <typename T>
struct storage
{
  alignas(T) unsigned char buf[N][sizeof(T)];

  T* make( int i, const std::string& name )
  {
    return new (buf[N - 1 - i]) T(name);
  }
};

static storage<reg_t> reg_store;
static storage<mem_t> mem_store;
static storage<sub_t> sub_store;
static storage<sub_t> top_store;

template <typename T>
void check( const std::string& what, const std::vector<T*>& objs,
            const std::string& prefix, int n )
{
  std::string got;
  for (unsigned int i = 0; i < objs.size(); i++)
    got += (i ? " " : "") + objs[i]->get_name();

  std::string exp;
  for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
    exp += (i ? " " : "") + prefix + std::to_string(i);

  std::cout << what << ": " << got << std::endl;
  if (got != exp)
    UVM_ERROR("Test", what + " returned '" + got + "', expected '" + exp + "'");
}

int sc_main(int, char*[])
{
  uvm_coreservice_t* cs = uvm_coreservice_t::get();
  uvm_report_server* svr = cs->get_report_server();

  std::vector<sub_t*> tops;
  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
  {
    tops.push_back(top_store.make(i, "top" + std::to_string(i)));
    tops[i]->configure(nullptr);
  }

  sub_t* top = tops[0];
  uvm_reg_map* map = top->create_map("map", 0, 1, UVM_LITTLE_ENDIAN);

  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
  {
    reg_t* rg = reg_store.make(i, "r" + std::to_string(i));
    rg->configure(top);
    rg->build();
    map->add_reg(rg, i);
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
  {
    mem_t* mem = mem_store.make(i, "m" + std::to_string(i));
    mem->configure(top);
    map->add_mem(mem, 0x100 * (i + 1));
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
  {
    sub_t* sub = sub_store.make(i, "b" + std::to_string(i));
    sub->configure(top);
    uvm_reg_map* submap = sub->create_map("s" + std::to_string(i), 0, 1, UVM_LITTLE_ENDIAN);
    map->add_submap(submap, 0x1000 * (i + 1));
  }

  for (int i = 0; i < N; i++)
    tops[i]->lock_model();

  std::vector<uvm_reg_block*> roots;
  uvm_reg_block::get_root_blocks(roots);
  check("get_root_blocks", roots, "top", N);

  std::vector<uvm_reg*> regs;
  top->get_registers(regs);
  check("block get_registers", regs, "r", N);

  std::vector<uvm_mem*> mems;
  top->get_memories(mems);
  check("block get_memories", mems, "m", N);

  std::vector<uvm_reg_block*> blks;
  top->get_blocks(blks);
  check("block get_blocks", blks, "b", N);

  regs.clear();
  map->get_registers(regs);
  check("map get_registers", regs, "r", N);

  mems.clear();
  map->get_memories(mems);
  check("map get_memories", mems, "m", N);

  std::vector<uvm_reg_map*> submaps;
  map->get_submaps(submaps);
  check("map get_submaps", submaps, "s", N);

  top->print();

  svr->report_summarize();

  if (svr->get_severity_count(UVM_FATAL) +
      svr->get_severity_count(UVM_ERROR) == 0)
    std::cout << "** UVM TEST PASSED **" << std::endl;
  else
    std::cout << "!! UVM TEST FAILED !!" << std::endl;

  return 0;
}
